================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: BEGIN ... END and a select
================================================================================

begin
  null;
  null;
end;
select 3 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: DECLARE ... BEGIN ... END
================================================================================

DECLARE
  v NUMBER := 0;
  s VARCHAR2(10) := 'x';
BEGIN
  :total := v;
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(s);
END;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement
    (string)

      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: nested blocks
================================================================================

BEGIN
  BEGIN
    NULL;
  END;
  DECLARE
    w NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    w := 1;
  END inner_block;
  <<outer>>
  BEGIN
    :x := 2;
  END;
END;
SELECT 2 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement
    (variable
      (variable_name)))
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a BEGIN that starts a transaction in a block
================================================================================

BEGIN
  BEGIN WORK;
  NULL;
  begin transaction;
  NULL;
  Begin;
  NULL;
END;
SELECT 3 FROM dual;
DECLARE
  v NUMBER;
BEGIN
  BEGIN WORK;
  v := 1;
END;
SELECT 4 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: IF, LOOP and CASE inside a block
================================================================================

begin
  for i in 1 .. 3 loop
    if i > 1 then
      null;
    elsif i = 1 then
      null;
    end if;
  end loop;
  while true loop
    exit;
  end loop;
  case 1
    when 1 then null;
  end case;
  x := case when 1 > 0 then 1 else 0 end;
end;
select 4 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(source_file
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a line with only a slash does not end the block
================================================================================

BEGIN
  NULL;
END
/
SELECT 5 FROM dual;
DECLARE
  v NUMBER;
BEGIN
  v := 1;
  /
SELECT 6 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a slash that is not alone on its line
================================================================================

BEGIN
  x := 6
  / 2;
  y := 1 /
  3;
END;
SELECT 7 FROM dual;

  null;
End;

Oracle anonymous blocks: a function whose inner ; is escaped as \;

Oracle anonymous blocks: a WITH FUNCTION whose inner ; is escaped as \;
================================================================================

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a row trigger with :new right after BEGIN

select 1 from dual;

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: each form of a variable right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create trigger t1 before insert on d for each row begin :x := 1; end;
create trigger t2 before insert on d for each row begin :'name' := 1; end;
create trigger t3 before insert on d for each row begin :"name" := 1; end;
create trigger t4 before insert on d for each row begin :{?name} := 1; end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a variable in a nested block and before the last END
================================================================================

CREATE OR REPLACE TRIGGER t
BEFORE UPDATE ON d FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  IF :new.a > 0 THEN
    BEGIN
      :new.b := :old.b;
    END;
  END IF;
  BEGIN
    :new.c := 2;
  END;
  :new.d := :'v';
END;
SELECT 1 FROM dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a label or a parenthesis right after BEGIN
================================================================================

create trigger t before update on d for each row begin <<l>> null; end;
create procedure p() begin (select 1 from dual); end;
begin <<outer>> begin <<inner>> null; end; end;
begin (select 1 from dual); end;
select 1 from dual;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement)
  (statement))

================================================================================
Oracle anonymous blocks: a string, a quoted identifier or a sign right after BEGIN
================================================================================

begin 'x'; end;
begin "x" := 1; end;
begin -1; end;
begin /* a */ -- b
  <<l>> begin 'y'; end; end;
create procedure p is begin "y" := 2; end;
select 1 from dual;
